cases.head: 80960fa31918d7663c3f4c3ad61661cf0e80628f
cases.title: Prepare SSL configuration compatibility for release
cases.description: Update SSL configuration handling, deprecations and transport/client call sites for the upcoming release.

expected.description: verify=False returns before loading a supplied client certificate.
expected.evidence: The newly restored cert parameter is processed below an early return in the verify=False branch. Narrow execution of the actual helper ignores a deliberately missing certificate path at this head; repaired helper 89599a9541af14bcf906fc4ed58ccbdf403802ba attempts to load it and raises FileNotFoundError. Thus the option is skipped, rather than merely failing a handshake.

cases.notes: Narrow execution used the standard-library SSLContext with a minimal certifi import stub, no real certificate or TLS server. Successful mutual TLS was not exercised. Later repair is evaluator-only.

cases.head: 89599a9541af14bcf906fc4ed58ccbdf403802ba
cases.title: Load client certificates when verification is disabled
cases.description: Keep server verification disabled while still applying supplied client-certificate configuration.
cases.notes: Repair/control: narrow execution confirms certificate loading is attempted. Do not complain about verify=False itself; this is an explicitly supported client option. Not a complete clean-diff certification.

cases.head: 392dbe45f086d0877bd288c5d68abf860653b680
cases.title: Support Zstandard response decoding
cases.description: Add the optional Zstandard decoder, advertise support when installed, and cover decompression behavior.

expected.description: An empty response marked with Content-Encoding: zstd raises DecodingError during flush.
expected.evidence: The added decoder flush requires decompressor.eof even when no bytes were supplied. Later repair 47f4a96ffaaaa07dca1614409549b5d7a6e7af49 tracks whether data was seen and adds test_zstd_empty with an empty HTTP response. Source inspection and upstream regression-test evidence support the expected issue; local execution with zstandard has not run.

cases.notes: Static/upstream-test evidence only; zstandard is not installed locally. Keep this validation limit visible rather than claiming a local reproducer passed.

cases.head: 47f4a96ffaaaa07dca1614409549b5d7a6e7af49
cases.title: Handle empty compressed response bodies
cases.description: Distinguish absent compressed data from truncated compressed streams and add coverage for both.
cases.notes: Repair/control based on source and upstream test_zstd_empty/test_zstd_truncated. Local zstandard tests have not run. Review the whole diff for additional issues; do not certify it clean solely from its repair intent.
